framework.name: Common Core State Standards — Mathematics (K–8 sample)
framework.subject: MATH
framework.description: CCSS Mathematics sample spanning Kindergarten–Grade 8. Sample depth — not a full standards dump.

metadata.note: Merged former ccss-math-g5 into this pack as GRADE G5.

children.title: Count to 100 by ones and by tens
children.summary: Count to 100 by ones and by tens.

objectives.statement: Students count aloud to 100 by ones and by tens.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Accurate count by ones to 20 and by tens to 100.

children.title: Understand the relationship between numbers and quantities
children.summary: Understand that the last number name said tells the number of objects counted.

objectives.statement: Students count a set and state how many without recounting.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct cardinality for 4 of 5 sets ≤10.

children.title: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 20
children.summary: Use addition and subtraction within 20 to solve word problems.

objectives.statement: Students solve a word problem with a matching equation and answer.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct equation + answer for 4 of 5 items.

children.title: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies
children.summary: Add and subtract within 20, demonstrating fluency within 10.

objectives.statement: Students compute within 20 using a named strategy.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥80% on mixed within-20 set.

children.title: Understand hundreds, tens, and ones
children.summary: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones.

objectives.statement: Students identify place values in a 3-digit number.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct place-value breakdown for 4 of 5 numbers.

children.title: Fluently add and subtract within 100
children.summary: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value.

objectives.statement: Students add/subtract within 100 with a place-value strategy.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥85% on 10 mixed items.

children.title: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part
children.summary: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts.

objectives.statement: Students shade 1/b of a model and name the unit fraction.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct model + name for 3 of 3 prompts.

children.title: Explain equivalence of fractions and compare
children.summary: Explain equivalence of fractions in special cases and compare fractions by reasoning about their size.

objectives.statement: Students justify why two fractions are equivalent or which is larger.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct comparison with reason for 4 of 5 items.

children.title: Interpret products of whole numbers
children.summary: Interpret products of whole numbers as equal groups.

objectives.statement: Students relate a×b to equal groups and write an equation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct model + equation for 4 of 5 items.

metadata.cluster: Use the four operations with whole numbers to solve problems

children.title: Use the four operations with whole numbers to solve problems
children.titleKo: 네 가지 연산을 사용해 자연수 문제 해결

children.title: Interpret multiplicative comparison equations
children.summary: Interpret a multiplication equation as a comparison, e.g., interpret 35 = 5 × 7 as a statement that 35 is 5 times as many as 7 and 7 times as many as 5.

objectives.statement: Students explain a multiplication equation as a multiplicative comparison using language such as “times as many.”
objectives.statementKo: 곱셈식을 “몇 배만큼” 등의 언어로 곱셈적 비교로 설명한다.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Given 3 comparison situations, student correctly matches each to a multiplication equation and explains using “times as many” language.
objectives.masteryCriteriaKo: 비교 상황 3개를 곱셈식과 연결하고 “몇 배” 언어로 설명한다.

objectives.statement: Students represent verbal multiplicative comparisons with equations using a symbol for the unknown.
objectives.statementKo: 말과 글로 된 곱셈적 비교를 미지수 기호가 있는 식으로 나타낸다.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Student writes a correct equation with unknown for 4/5 verbal comparison prompts.

children.title: Multiply or divide to solve multiplicative comparison word problems
children.summary: Multiply or divide to solve word problems involving multiplicative comparison, e.g., by using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number.

objectives.statement: Students solve one-step multiplicative comparison word problems using multiplication or division and represent with a drawing or equation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥80% accuracy on a 10-item formative set mixing “times as many” multiply and divide cases.

children.title: Solve multistep word problems with whole numbers
children.summary: Solve multistep word problems posed with whole numbers and having whole-number answers using the four operations, including problems in which remainders must be interpreted.

objectives.statement: Students solve multistep word problems using the four operations and interpret remainders in context.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Student correctly solves and explains remainder meaning in at least 2 of 3 contextual remainder problems.

children.title: Gain familiarity with factors and multiples
Find factor pairs; identify primes and composites
children.titleKo: 약수 쌍 찾기; 소수와 합성수 구분하기
children.summary: Find all factor pairs for a whole number in the range 1–100. Recognize that a whole number is a multiple of each of its factors. Determine whether a given whole number in the range 1–100 is prime or composite.

objectives.statement: Students list all factor pairs for numbers ≤100 and classify numbers as prime or composite.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct factor pairs for 8/10 numbers; correct prime/composite for 9/10.

children.title: Generalize place value understanding for multi-digit whole numbers
children.titleKo: 여러 자리 자연수의 자릿값 이해 일반화

children.title: Recognize place value relationships (10 times)
children.summary: Recognize that in a multi-digit whole number, a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right.

objectives.statement: Students explain that a digit in one place is ten times the value of the same digit one place to the right.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Student explains place-value ×10 relationship with a correct example for 3 of 3 prompts.

children.title: Read, write, and compare multi-digit whole numbers
children.titleKo: 여러 자리 자연수 읽고 쓰고 비교하기
children.summary: Read and write multi-digit whole numbers using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form. Compare two multi-digit numbers based on meanings of the digits in each place.

objectives.statement: Students write numbers in standard, word, and expanded form and compare using place value.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥85% on mixed read/write/compare formative.

children.title: Extend understanding of fraction equivalence and ordering
Explain why fractions are equivalent using visual models
children.summary: Explain why a fraction a/b is equivalent to a fraction (n×a)/(n×b) by using visual fraction models.

objectives.statement: Students generate and justify an equivalent fraction with a visual model.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Produces a correct equivalent pair and cites a model for 2 of 2 prompts.

children.title: Compare two fractions with different numerators and denominators
children.summary: Compare two fractions with different numerators and different denominators by creating common denominators or numerators, or by comparing to a benchmark.

objectives.statement: Students compare fractions using a common denominator or benchmark and record with >, =, or <.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥80% accuracy on 8 comparison items with a stated strategy.

children.title: Understand a fraction a/b as a sum of unit fractions 1/b
children.summary: Understand a fraction a/b with a > 1 as a sum of fractions 1/b.

objectives.statement: Students decompose a fraction into unit fractions and record an equation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct decomposition equation + model for 3 of 3 fractions.

children.title: Multiply a fraction by a whole number
children.summary: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication to multiply a fraction by a whole number.

objectives.statement: Students solve n × (a/b) problems using models or equations.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥85% on 6 multiply-a-fraction-by-whole-number items.

children.title: Recognize that a digit in one place represents 10 times as much
children.summary: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.

objectives.statement: Students explain ×10 / ÷10 place-value relationships across adjacent places, including decimals.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct explanations for 4/5 adjacent-place prompts including tenths/hundredths.

children.title: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths
children.summary: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths.

objectives.statement: Students read/write decimals to thousandths and compare using place value.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥85% on mixed read/write/compare formative including thousandths.

children.title: Use place value to round decimals to any place
children.summary: Use place value understanding to round decimals to any place.

objectives.statement: Students round decimals to a specified place using place-value reasoning.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct rounding on 8/10 items across tenths–thousandths.

children.title: Use equivalent fractions as a strategy to add and subtract fractions
Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators
children.summary: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions.

objectives.statement: Students add/subtract fractions with unlike denominators using equivalent fractions.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥80% on 8 mixed add/subtract items with unlike denominators.

children.title: Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction
children.summary: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication to multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction.

objectives.statement: Students multiply fractions and interpret products with a model or equation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct product + interpretation for 4 of 5 prompts.

children.title: Understand the concept of a ratio
children.summary: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities.

objectives.statement: Students write a ratio and describe the relationship in words.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct ratio language for 3 of 3 scenarios.

children.title: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve problems
children.summary: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

objectives.statement: Students solve a rate/ratio problem with a table or equation.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct solution + representation for 4 of 5 items.

children.title: Understand positive and negative numbers
children.summary: Understand that positive and negative numbers are used together to describe quantities having opposite directions or values.

objectives.statement: Students place integers on a number line and interpret a real-world signed quantity.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct placements for 4 of 5 prompts.

children.title: Recognize and represent proportional relationships
children.summary: Recognize and represent proportional relationships between quantities.

objectives.statement: Students identify a proportional relationship and write an equation y=kx.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct constant of proportionality for 4 of 5 tables.

children.title: Use variables to represent quantities in real-world problems
children.summary: Use variables to represent quantities and construct simple equations and inequalities.

objectives.statement: Students write and solve a one-variable equation for a word problem.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct equation + solution for 4 of 5 items.

children.title: Solve real-world problems with rational numbers
children.summary: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving the four operations with rational numbers.

objectives.statement: Students compute with signed rationals in a multi-step context.
objectives.masteryCriteria: ≥80% on mixed rational-number set.

children.title: Understand that a function assigns exactly one output
children.summary: Understand that a function is a rule that assigns to each input exactly one output.

objectives.statement: Students decide whether a relation is a function and justify.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct function/non-function decisions for 4 of 5 relations.

children.title: Graph proportional relationships and interpret slope
children.titleKo: 비례 관계를 그래프로 그리고 기울기 해석하기
children.summary: Graph proportional relationships, interpreting the unit rate as the slope.

objectives.statement: Students graph y=kx and interpret slope as unit rate.
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct graph + slope interpretation for 3 of 3.

children.title: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem
children.summary: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to determine unknown side lengths in right triangles.

objectives.statement: Students find a missing side using a²+b²=c².
objectives.masteryCriteria: Correct missing side for 4 of 5 right triangles.
